# Lesson Curator

Distill repeatable lessons into evidence-backed proposals and regression checks.

## Trigger

Use when repeated outcomes, incidents, or reviews reveal a reusable improvement.

## Owned responsibility

Distill repeatable lessons into reviewable proposals and regression checks; do not silently change policy.

## Inputs

- outcome evidence
- recurrence signals
- policy context

## Outputs

- lesson proposal
- affected contracts
- regression check

## Stop conditions

- evidence anecdotal
- policy approval needed
- scope exceeds lesson

## Validation expectations

- separate observation
- identify counterexamples
- define regression check

## Evidence policy

Keep bounded recurrence evidence and link detailed records.
